name: Reason of Detective
source:
A detective suddenly loses memory just before she calls out the name of the criminal. She does not remember anything about the case or the person, so she talks to the people and tries to solve the case by reasoning alone.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
侦探正要说出罪犯的名字，却突然失去了记忆。她不记得案件，也不记得那个人，只能与相关人员交谈，单凭推理尝试解决案件。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-november-2004-planetarian.html]vndbreview[/url]]
